verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs position the DGX B200 for LLM inference, claiming 15X the inference performance of the previous generation, and point to NVIDIA deployment tooling such as NIM and NeMo. None of those materials are tied specifically to B200 serving configurations, and no low-precision format is named. Missing for 10: any documentation of FP8/FP4 support on B200, any named support for TensorRT-LLM or vLLM (or llama.cpp) on this part, B200-specific serving guidance, and independent hands-on inference corroboration.
